scope: Public MCP docs, three README copies, versioned Changelog, release-note rendering and publication guards

checks.wheel_docs: README and METADATA clean with exact source parity

negative_cases: Nested task/spec identifiers, missing docs, mismatched README copies, duplicate Unreleased, unordered versions, contaminated wheel METADATA, missing wheel doc, contaminated release notes and CI/help labels, missing/unknown release version
compatibility: No tool name, arguments, response/schema, guard/security semantics, dependency or runtime behavior changed. Corrected current tool-registration wording matches runtime.compose. Preserved immutable canonical assets and fixtures. Historical originals retained internally.
limitations: No native foreign Rust holder test or Windows backend executed locally (two skips). Existing SDK/Pydantic warning recorded. No licensed-host claim, release/tag, remote release-body update or existing installed-wheel replacement.
rollback: Revert editorial/guard/renderer source commits; published tags/assets and user configuration are unchanged.
